title: Social medicine in practice
summary: Survey of physicians and psychological psychotherapists regarding the socio-medical care of their unemployed and work-incapacitated patients.

interventions.name: Study participants are doctors and psychological psychotherapists (N=200).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Doctors and psychological psychotherapists, licensed or in training, who treat disabled or unemployed patients.
Exclusion criteria:
Physicians/psychotherapists do not work in outpatient care.
